schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to make unexpected trips, even out of town?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في القيام برحلات غير متوقعة، حتى خارج المدينة؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, unvorhergesehene Fahrten zu machen, auch außerhalb der Stadt?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to make unexpected trips, even out of town?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که سفرهای پیش‌بینی‌نشده، حتی خارج از شهر، انجام دهید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de faire des trajets imprévus, même hors de la ville ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy váratlan utakat megtenni, akár a városon kívülre is?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a fare spostamenti imprevisti, anche fuori città?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, şehir dışı da dahil, beklenmedik yolculuklar yapmaktan vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
